summary: Phase 5A Staff Management testing completed successfully. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified: Staff List with table display, search, status filter, Add Employee with PIN dialog, Edit Employee, Reset PIN, Reset TOTP, Deactivate, and Activate.

backend_api: GET /api/employees/list - Returns all employees with correct fields (id, employee_id, first_name, last_name, job_title, status, etc.)
POST /api/employees/create - Creates employee with auto-generated employee_id and PIN
POST /api/employees/create - Returns new PIN in response for manager to hand-copy
POST /api/employees/create - Auto-generates ID based on job_title (NRS for nurses, CAR for carers, etc.)
PUT /api/employees/{emp_id}/reset-pin - Returns new 4-digit PIN in response
PUT /api/employees/{emp_id}/reset-pin - Returns employee_id and name with PIN
PUT /api/employees/{emp_id}/reset-totp - Resets TOTP secret with success message
PUT /api/employees/{emp_id}/deactivate - Changes employee status to inactive
PUT /api/employees/{emp_id}/activate - Changes employee status to active
All endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
frontend_flows: Manager demo login: Manager button → PIN 1234 → /manager dashboard
Staff List navigation: Click 'Staff List' in sidebar → Staff Management component loads
Staff table displays: Employee (name, email), ID, Role, Type, Contract, Status, Actions columns
Search by name: Type 'Emma' → filters to show Emma Thompson
Search by ID: Type 'NRS001' → filters to show Emma Thompson (NRS001)
Status filter - Active: Default view shows 17+ active employees
Status filter - Inactive: Shows 2-3 inactive employees (John Smith, Mary Johnson)
Status filter - All: Shows all 21+ employees
Add Employee button: Opens create-employee-modal with form fields
Add Employee form: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, Job Title (select), Employment Type (select), Contract Hours
Add Employee submit: Creates employee, shows pin-result-dialog with generated PIN (e.g., 1631)
PIN Result Dialog: Shows employee name, ID, 4-digit PIN code, Copy/Print/Done buttons
Actions menu: Click ⋮ button opens dropdown with Edit Details, Reset PIN, Reset TOTP, Manager Notes, Deactivate/Activate
Edit Details: Opens edit-employee-modal with pre-filled employee data
Edit Employee submit: Updates employee, change reflects in table (e.g., contract hours)
Reset PIN action: Shows pin-result-dialog with new PIN (e.g., 2664) for manager to copy
Reset TOTP action: Triggers alert message 'TOTP reset. Staff member must re-enroll on mobile app.'
Deactivate action: Changes employee status to Inactive, removes from Active filter view
Activate action (from Inactive filter): Changes employee status to Active, removes from Inactive filter view

test_credentials.staff: NRS001, PIN: varies (was reset during testing)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test employees created during testing: TestUser AutoGenerated (CAR005), TestNurse AutoID (NRS003), UITest Employee (NRS004). Test Updated (CAR004) was used for edit/deactivate/activate tests with contract hours changed from 24h to 30h.
